## How to add a source, in full

1. Run `tools/legal_capture.py` **before** writing the collector. If the
   capture comes back disallowed, stop there and record it as such.
2. Add the source to `research/SOURCE_REGISTRY.json` with the same id.
3. Re-run `python -B tools/build_provenance_index.py` and commit the
   regenerated index together with the capture, in one commit.
4. Re-capture whenever the terms could have changed, and at least once
   before anything is published. Old captures are never deleted — a
   permission that was true in 2026 is part of the record even if the
   site changes its mind in 2027.
